after: Private capture includes active scoped field identities and route configuration hashes. Internal pin lookup verifies the selected published attribute against those facts and freshly joined metadata, then performs an exact read-only source SELECT and reobserves at finish.
actual_evidence: 81/[205]: 89 active governed field mappings verified; one distinct locator; 290 supported static records. Metadata only, no business-value query.
initial_findings: First test fixture incorrectly used logical IDs instead of publication generation record IDs; corrected the new fixture to use actual pinned candidates.

Coverage distinguishes route configuration from actual server identity and mutable business values.
Initial SQL loopback transport failure retained; two independent reruns and final complete suite pass without source changes.
An incorrectly scoped Oagnet runner invocation collected backups. Corrected to its real tests directory; final collection errors zero.

Published attribute record ID, canonical owner, mapping and source agreement
Parameterized exact SELECT, quoted governed identifiers, read-only transaction, rollback/close on errors
Binary matching retains distinct normalization collisions; truncation is explicit

remaining: Agent Raw/Pending/filter bindings and restored observations still require integration; this is not an end-to-end entity-value PASS

Route hash proves configured locator, not DNS/server UUID or SQL execution snapshot; no point-in-time cross-source atomicity is claimed
Native catalog publication remains absent; current candidate must be regenerated after operational authorization
